title: Mapping
description: Schema for a source-to-target field mapping document. Captures field-level mappings between source and target systems including transformation rules, business rules, data quality rule references, lineage, and confidence level for each mapped item.

mapping_id.description: Unique identifier for this mapping document.

created_by.description: Identity of the person or agent that created this mapping.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this mapping was created.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this mapping document.

source_entity.description: Source table, object, or entity name.

source_type.description: Data type of the source field.

target_entity.description: Target table, object, or entity name.

target_type.description: Data type of the target field.

transformation_rule.description: Description or expression defining the transformation applied to the source value.

dq_rule_refs.description: References to data quality rules applicable to this mapping.

lineage_ref.description: Reference to a lineage record tracking this field mapping.

notes.description: Additional notes or caveats for this mapping entry.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the correctness of this mapping.
